title: Verify conversational human feedback and existing seed/priming receipts
description:
As an editor, I want my explicit publication-specific decisions and reasons preserved and applied through the correct authenticated feedback path, so alignment uses actual human judgments rather than inferred labels.

Current: 50 explicit human decisions, explanations, source/presentation selection provenance and message provenance are saved privately with hashes. Zero feedback/learning application. Deliberately selected candidate batches are not random evaluation samples; no accuracy claim may be inferred from their hit rate. No individual labels, reasons or policy prose belong in public tracker text.

Pending gate: verified production target decision/output/binding revision, current human authority/delegation and intended applied-feedback transport are not established. Preserve baseline-before-seeding and evaluation separation. Do not fabricate predictions, authority, examples or an applied receipt. Do not implicitly activate classifiers or training.

Feature: Faithful authority-bound human feedback
Scenario: Preserve a confirmed decision
Given an actual human publication-specific decision with its reason and message provenance
When feedback is received
Then preserve it privately and distinguish received status from applied status.
Scenario: Refuse a missing target
Given no verified current prediction/output binding or human application authority
When feedback application is requested
Then retain the received decision without applying learning or inventing an application receipt.
Scenario: Verify application after the gate is resolved
Given a verified scoped target and valid current human authority
When the intended authorized feedback operation completes
Then read back its actual applied receipt and preserve the source decision and ordering.

Focused local verification: 63 tests; 3 BDD features/24 scenarios/98 steps. Source review remains open; nothing merged or deployed. Private review holds 50 received human decisions, zero applied feedback/learning. Credential-free manual HN collection queued 30; parent reports hourly automation enabled, first automatic receipt still unverified. Full routing/classification is not running. Exact remaining gates: select deployed consumer/release and scoped read permissions; verify authenticated publication/tenant/section data and current context at provider boundary; obtain scoped policy-write/live-provider budget authorization where needed; bind predictions and human authority before feedback application; observe scheduled-run receipt. Keep policy, labels and rationales private.
